task: SHELFCHECK — SEARCH HARDENING + SAFE ZERO-RESULT UX (fix/search-hardening-and-zero-results)
note: Search/UX reliability pass only. Census membership, ownership, and the runtime finalization architecture are untouched -- INCLUDED remains 2,535 throughout.

pipelineInspected.finding: app.js's own render() (line 32) is dead code at runtime -- model-fix.js defines a full replacement `function render(){...}` (a plain redeclaration, not a wrap) that actually executes, since it loads after app.js and JS function declarations sharing the same global scope let the later one win outright. price-fix.js and price-sort-v063.js then genuinely WRAP that model-fix.js render (capture-and-call-through), for price-card decoration and price sorting respectively. All search matching (the `x.search.includes(q)` predicate) and the 'Nothing matched.' zero-result HTML live entirely inside model-fix.js's render() -- the one place this pass needed to change.
pipelineInspected.reason: Editing the single existing, actually-executing render() implementation in place is far more surgical than adding another wrapper layer that would need to reimplement or intercept an inline mid-function conditional; matches how the prior price-sort-bug fix (PR #28) and runtime-determinism fix (PR #29) also edited core files directly rather than adding new wrapper indirection for core-algorithm changes.

searchMatching.existingBehaviorPreserved: The plain substring check (x.search.includes(q)) is still the FIRST and primary match path, completely unchanged -- both query and every title/alias already pass through the same norm() before comparison, so punctuation differences (dragon-ball / dragon.ball / dragon ball) were already handled before this pass and remain handled identically.
searchMatching.newMechanism: A second, narrower match path: a 'compact' representation of the search text (its normalized tokens, minus a tiny fixed stopword list, joined with no spaces) is checked as a substring only when the query's own compact form is 5+ characters. This closes exactly two gaps: (1) the query omits whitespace the target has ('dragonb' vs 'dragon ball the breakers'), and (2) the query skips a short connecting word the target has ('princepersia' vs 'prince of persia').
searchMatching.stopwordListDeliberatelyExcludes: Single-letter words ('a', 'an') were tested and removed from the stopword list after they produced a genuine false positive: stripping 'a' from 'Twin Breaker: A Sacred Symbols Adventure' let 'breaker' + 'sacred' spell 'breakers' across the word boundary, matching a query for 'breakers' that should not have matched it. Restricting the stopword list to 3+ letter words eliminated this without losing any required test case (princepersia only needs 'of' stripped).
searchMatching.minimumLengthReason: Guarantees every existing short/ambiguous query (the false-positive guardrail set: 'dra', 'the', 'game', 'ball', 'ps', 'xx', 'a', 'of', 'and') resolves through the EXACT SAME substring check as before this pass, byte-for-byte -- the new compact path never engages for them, so their result counts are provably unchanged (see falsePositiveGuardrails.results below).
searchMatching.aliasesIncluded: x.search already includes appended aliases (space-joined) at every item's creation site; the compact representation is derived from that same field, so aliases participate in both match paths identically to the title.

falsePositiveGuardrails.method: For every query, computed both the OLD (plain substring-only) match count and the NEW (substring OR compact) match count directly against the live 2,535-item runtime, filtered exactly as the ALL view filters (excludes EXCLUDED-set items).

spiderman.note: Correctly finds the same 3 Spider-Man titles via the compact path.

thebreakers.note: Merged word with an embedded stopword ('the') typed with no internal space does not resolve -- stopword-stripping only applies to whole tokens split on real spaces, not substrings inside an already-merged word. Not a required test case; staying at 0 is safe (no false positive), just an unhandled edge case, left as-is per 'wrong match is worse than no match.'

falsePositivesFoundDuringDevelopment.issue: Before excluding single-letter stopwords, stripping 'a' from 'Twin Breaker: A Sacred Symbols Adventure' produced compact text containing 'breakers' (breaker+sacred bridging), incorrectly matching a query for 'breakers'.
falsePositivesFoundDuringDevelopment.fixApplied: Removed 'a'/'an' from the stopword list, keeping only 3+ letter words ('the','of','and'). Re-verified 'breakers' returns exactly the same 3 results as before this pass.
